name: Battery
author: WinDock
description: The battery's level as a battery glyph (red when low, a bolt while charging) with the percentage and, optionally, the time left. A click opens a popup with the state and Power & battery settings. A PC without a battery shows a crossed battery, or nothing.

settings.label: Show the percentage
settings.description: Writes the charge level in percent next to the battery. On by default.

settings.label: Show the time left (on battery, when Windows knows it)
settings.description: Adds how long the battery will last, when Windows has an estimate. Off by default.

settings.label: Low from
settings.description: At or below this level the battery is drawn red.

settings.label: Take no room on a PC without a battery
settings.description: Off: a crossed battery and "No battery".
